interpretations: V8: Track00060 30-90 s stereo, block 256 (= one hop), host wall time of pvb_process summed per run, min over 3 interleaved runs per build; worst hop time = per-256-sample-block time (one hop plus the rest of the chain) max, median over runs

definitions.tone_steady: V1/V2: 4 s, 100 Hz + 200 + 300 Hz (amplitudes 1:0.5:0.18, sine phase 0), waveform peak -12 dBFS, 8 ms linear attack, steady until the end
definitions.bass_notes: bare bass: a note every 0.5 s on 100 Hz (partials 1:0.5:0.18), 8 ms attack, exp(-u/0.35 s) decay, peak 0.25; 9 s for V3a/b/d, 8 s for V4 (research_r4l_timing_layer / gate_flicker recipe)
definitions.flicker: V4 signals (research_r4l_gate_flicker.py): bass+pink = bare bass + pink noise rms 0.03 (-30.5 dBFS, seed 1, 1/max(f,20 Hz) power); bass+kick+pink = bare bass + 0.2*kick + the same pink. 8 s, notes 2..15 used
definitions.stepwise_line: V3c: 40 notes of 125 ms, 98<->104 Hz (notes 0-19) then 98<->110 Hz (notes 20-39); each note restarts at sine phase 0, partials 1:0.5:0.18, peak 0.25, linear 8 ms attack AND 8 ms release (flat sustain); plus pink noise (seed 1) scaled so bass power / noise power in 80-200 Hz = 25 dB (base) or 6 dB. Evaluated notes: 2..39 except 20
definitions.gated_line: V3h: the stepwise line with 125 ms of no-note after every 125 ms note (period 250 ms, 10 s); same notes, same pink bed scaled to in-band SNR 25 / 6 dB, the bass power taken over the note-on samples
definitions.chatter_tone: V3i: the V1 tone for 10 s on pink (seed 1) at in-band (80-200 Hz) SNR 8 dB
definitions.tail_note: V3d tail (reported only): one 100 Hz note on [0.5, 1.5) s, 1:0.5:0.18, peak 0.25, 8 ms attack and release, then 2 s of silence
definitions.close_pair: V3e: 100 Hz + (100+df) Hz, df = 4 and 10 Hz; each tone = 0.5 x the V1 tone (partials 1:0.5:0.18, sine phase 0), 4 s, 8 ms attack, no noise; the "alone" references are the single tones at the same level
definitions.weak_tail_attack: V3f: 3.0 s; pink bed (seed 3) whose rms makes the 110 Hz note SNR 25 dB; 80 Hz note (1:0.5:0.18) from 0.2 s, steady (fundamental 0.1) to 0.9 s, then exp decay so its SNR is 7 dB at T_a = 1.4 s; 110 Hz note (fundamental 0.1, 1:0.5:0.18, 8 ms attack/release) on [1.4, 2.9). SNR measured on the input as in spec 5.4
definitions.low_notes: V3g: 35 Hz on [0.3,2.3) s and 45 Hz on [2.8,4.8) s; fundamental and 2nd harmonic both amplitude 0.1 (sine phase 0), 8 ms attack/release, no noise
definitions.pink_only: V9: 10 s pink noise rms 10^(-30/20) (-30 dBFS), seed 1
definitions.music_silence_noise: V9 composite (14 s): Track00060 song time 40-43 s | 2 s silence | 4 s pink -30 dBFS rms | 2 s silence | Track00060 43-46 s; scored on input time 4-10.9 s (after the first music ends, before the second begins)
